
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qq21497936/p/19525598" title="发布于 2026-01-24 11:14">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SVN培训笔记（二）：使用sourceTree通过git桥接管理svn项目</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1>前言</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  使用sourcetree管理git非常方便，还能额外调用beyond Compare，非常方便，但是git管理权限，是直接服务器用户管理，svn可以通过文本管理，结合sourcetree，最终定好是通过sourceTree管理svn。</p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="1git_5"></a>解决痛点1：git权限管理问题</h1>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  使用svn进行文件管理权限，可以直接配置文本和用户，仓库之间共用配置文件。<br>  下面是svn对用户的管理：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420820-1259881694.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  下面是svn对项目权限和文件夹的管理：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420916-102345833.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="2svn_13"></a>解决痛点2：svn文件版本对比更新问题</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  使用svn查看文件无法直接调用外部beyond compare，且一次提交多个文件，没有一个明显的分类，都是在一个列表中，而sourcetree就完美解决了这个问题。<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420917-1085456546.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="_20"></a>核心关键点</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  使用git初始化svn仓库后，svn的提交版本信息，会按照git在sourcetree中的方式，显示的区分：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420861-521689426.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="sourceTreeSVN_26"></a>使用sourceTree部署服务器SVN项目</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="sourceTree_27"></a>步骤一：安装sourceTree</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  下载sourceTree，其是免费的软件，下载安装。（略）<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420847-1172691155.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="svn_31"></a>步骤二：获取项目的svn地址</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  获取项目的svn地址。（略）</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="svngit_33"></a>步骤三：先使用svn地址初始化git桥接的本地仓库</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-cpp">git svn init svn地址
</code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420852-250816467.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="_39"></a>步骤四：拉取本地仓库</h2>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  这里不要用sourceTree直接添加仓库进行拉取fetch，拉不下来，因为要输入svn的账户和密码，测试sourceTree在这一步没有弹出。<br>  所以在git本目录svn拉取：</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<pre><code class="prism language-shell"><span class="token function">git svn fetch
</span></code></pre>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420832-146251810.png" class="lazyload"></p>
</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  注意连续弹出的三个对话框，第一个无所谓，第二个是svn的账号，第三个是svn的密码。<br>  拉取成功如下图：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420856-1351928199.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="sourceTree_51"></a>步骤五：使用sourceTree加载该仓库</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  打开应用：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420870-1481975047.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420812-1365190273.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  添加仓库（初始化为本地git仓库）：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420825-1205445084.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  添加到git的目录即可：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420841-1686233279.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  然后添加后，将之前svn的各种版本信息也都类似于git管理展示出来了：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420840-1196681751.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="sourceTree_69"></a>sourceTree管理界面基础详解</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420859-512614137.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="SourceTree_75"></a>SourceTree调用外部对比</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  选择对应记录后的对应版本，可以对指定文件进行格外的单独对比：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420918-848566129.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  但是需要配置第三方工具，配置步骤如下：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420859-1797611735.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420895-331308601.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  然后再次使用：<br>  <img alt="在这里插入图片描述" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1971530/202601/1971530-20260124111420862-551766599.png" class="lazyload"></p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  在这一块sourceTree应该是非常好用的。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h1><a id="_91"></a>入坑</h1>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h2><a id="git_fetchsourceTreefetch_92"></a>入坑一：不使用git fetch直接在sourceTree中fetch卡住</h2>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_93"></a>问题</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  初始化仓库后，直接用sourceTree进行拉取，拉取失败。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_95"></a>原因</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  因为在srouceTree中用的是git fetch，实际是svn，所以无法拉取下来。</p>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<h3><a id="_97"></a>解决</h3>


</div>
<div class="cl-preview-section">
<p>  在git命令行中进行fetch，这样弹出三个方框进行输入svn的账户和密码等信息，可以fetch。</p>


</div>
</div>
